_comment: What the app says the same way in every skill.
This pack belongs to no skill, which is the whole point: before it existed the
number words lived in counting's folder, and addition's count-along was instant
only because counting happened to be installed. Removing counting would have
A line belongs here when it names no subject. 'seven' is 'seven', and 'Perfect!'
is as true of a story problem as of a ten-frame. A line that mentions what is
being learned - 'Brilliant counting!', 'You put them together!' - belongs to the
skill that teaches it, and stays in that skill's own voice.json.
Record it with: npm run voice:record -- --skill common
_phrasesComment: Facts about how numbers are written, not about any one skill's subject.
Counting says them building a ten; addition says them regrouping a column.
_groupsComment: Praise and correction that name no subject.
A skill's own reactions are played alongside these, never instead of them, so
a skill that has recorded nothing still sounds finished and one that has
recorded its own flavour keeps it. What a skill must never hear is another
skill's words: 'Brilliant counting!' after 7 + 3 is the bug scoping prevents.
